summary: Frontend testing for AdminPassportPhoto/VesikalikWorkspace 3-bug fixes. All primary must-pass items validated on /admin/vesikalik as admin. BUG1 (state persistence), single/sheet canvas render, watermark strip controls + redraw, and print/download flows all pass without console errors.

test_results.BUG1_state_persistence: PASS - Uploaded slots 0 & 1 in triple mode; switched to Tekli and back to 3'lü İşleme; both slot previews (vt-slot-0, vt-slot-1) still contained img/canvas markup after round-trip.
test_results.single_editor_canvas_render: PASS - auto-bg-toggle was ON by default, toggled OFF. Uploaded via #vf. canvas-single = 591x709 (client 292x350), canvas-sheet = 1535x2126 (client 253x350). Non-zero, no JS errors.
test_results.watermark_controls_and_redraw: PASS - watermark-upload accepts PNG. All 11 controls present (wm-align-left/center/right, wm-move-up/down/left/right/center, wm-scale, wm-opacity, watermark-remove). All movement + alignment clicks executed without exception. watermark-remove removed the controls (align/move disappeared).
test_results.quick_print: PASS - quick-print-btn triggered success toast 'Baskı penceresi açıldı'. Zero new console errors after click. Hidden-iframe print approach works.
test_results.inject_overflow_subtest: SKIPPED (per instructions) - bg-removal model loading was blocked in test environment ('Model yüklenemedi. İnternet bağlantınızı kontrol edin.' toast observed). Environment limitation only; fit fix is deterministic in code review.

console_errors: Only 2 background 401s (unrelated auth polling), 0 errors during print/watermark/canvas interactions.
critical_code_review_comments: The auto-bg-toggle defaults to ON, which forces the ~40MB model download on first load; consider defaulting OFF or lazy-loading only when user opts in, to avoid the model-load error toast on entry (not part of current bug scope).
AdminPassportPhoto.jsx is likely large (multiple bug fixes stacked); consider splitting sheet-drawing (drawSheet, drawWm) into a helper module for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs (state persistence across triple<->single toggle, watermark strip controls, print via hidden iframe) verified fixed. Inject/overflow sub-test skipped due to bg-removal model network limitation in browser sandbox — main agent should manually validate the fit-inside-canvas behavior after clicking vt-finetune-0 if desired.
